beats.vo: This tiny light is a trap.
Two thousand meters down, where sunlight never reaches, the anglerfish dangles a glowing lure. Swim too close, and you're dinner.
Every spring off Japan, millions of firefly squid flash electric blue, turning the black water into a starfield.
Some jellyfish light up when they're attacked. It's a burglar alarm that calls in bigger predators to eat the attacker.
The vampire squid doesn't drink blood. When it's threatened, it releases a cloud of glowing mucus, and vanishes.
On some nights, the glow reaches the shore, and every breaking wave lights up blue.
Down there, three out of four animals make their own light. The deep sea isn't dark. It's glowing.
